empty.title: No handover yet

documents.title: Handover documents

afterHandover.title: After handover
afterHandover.hint: Retention and guarantees are returned when they fall due under the contract

none.title: The warranty has not started
none.hint: The warranty starts when the customer accepts the work

claims.assigneeRequired: Pick a team member or a supplier (at least one)

empty.title: No warranty claims
